sources.caption:
Alhamdulillah for a beautiful evening at Masjid Ahmad Ibrahim. 🤍

Yesterday, we were blessed with the melodious recitation of Qasidah by the Imams and Bilals of Masjid Ahmad Ibrahim, followed by Kuliah “Insan Terpilih Nabi ﷺ” by Ustaz Ali Atan.

Our heartfelt appreciation to all jemaah who took the time to join us and enliven the masjid with your presence. May every step taken towards the House of Allah be counted as an act of ibadah and bring us closer to Him. 

We hope to continue seeing our jemaah filling the masjid—not only for our major events, but for the many kuliah, programmes and gatherings held throughout the year.

The masjid is more meaningful when it is filled with its community. Let us continue to learn, connect and grow together in the House of Allah. 

InsyaAllah, we look forward to welcoming you again at our upcoming programmes at Masjid Ahmad Ibrahim.
